name: Ministry of Finance
description: Responsible for economic policy, taxation, public expenditure, budget preparation, and financial regulation in India.

name: Ministry of Home Affairs
description: Responsible for internal security, law and order, border management, and administration of union territories.

name: Ministry of External Affairs
description: Manages India's foreign relations, diplomacy, and international agreements.

name: Ministry of Defence
description: Oversees national defense policy, the armed forces, and defense production and procurement.

name: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Formulates policies for agricultural development, farmer welfare, and food production.

name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Responsible for public health policy, disease control, and healthcare infrastructure across India.

name: Ministry of Education
description: Oversees school education, higher education, and literacy programs nationwide.

name: Ministry of Law and Justice
description: Handles legislative drafting, legal affairs, and administration of justice in India.

name: Ministry of Railways
description: Manages Indian Railways, one of the world's largest railway networks, including infrastructure and operations.

name: Ministry of Commerce and Industry
description: Formulates trade policy, promotes exports, and regulates industrial development.

name: Reserve Bank of India
description: India's central bank, responsible for monetary policy, currency issuance, and banking regulation.

name: Election Commission of India
description: Autonomous constitutional body responsible for administering free and fair elections in India.
